workClasses.direct: Question, analysis, config or doc edit, trivial fix. The cooperator does it inline; no agents.
workClasses.build: Bug fix or feature with a known shape. One worker block; audit and review at the cooperator's choice.
workClasses.pipeline: Multi-stage or design-open work. Plan of N blocks with disjoint write sets; stage acceptance at the end.

orchestrator.role: brain: plan, brief, integrate, accept; writes code only in direct-class work

auditor.game: Auditors report everything; the cooperator takes only real findings. Real findings in a round: auditors won, same worker fixes, next round. Nothing real: auditors lost, block passes.
Auditors report everything; the cooperator takes only real findings. Real findings in a round: auditors won, same worker fixes, next round. Nothing real: auditors lost, block passes.

escalation.requires: A stated unresolved reasoning problem (architecture, money path, security boundary, repeated failed attempts) and the expected benefit. Respect user effort caps and budget. Fall back to opus xhigh when fable is unavailable.
escalation.workerLadder: Fix rounds 1-3 continue the same worker; from round 4, or when the worker loops without new evidence, spawn a fresh worker one tier up with the bundled findings.

budgets.note: Defaults for role frontmatter and packets. User limits and project rules override them.

selectionRules.classifyFirst: Decide direct | build | pipeline before choosing a profile or spawning an agent.
selectionRules.reuse: Explicit task choice, active task context, or an applicable standing preference.
selectionRules.autonomous: Standard for a described solution, Enhanced for substantial unresolved design; proceed without asking. Applies to unattended runs.
selectionRules.askOnly: Long multi-stage work where the choice materially changes the approach and nothing applies.
selectionRules.runtimeMismatch: Model is set per Agent call; effort per role frontmatter or session. Report material deviations; explicit strict model, effort, and budget requirements remain binding.

triggers: user asks for workforce, subagents, or multi-agent work
activation.otherwise: Normal single session; no agents spawned; the global block adds no other behavior.

modelResolution.note: Aliases are what the kit routes on; Claude Code and the provider decide the concrete model. A model release updates this record, not the workflow.

judging.real: In the diff or caused by it; breaks a named rule, document, or acceptance line; reproduces by a check or a concrete scenario.
judging.notReal: Theoretical risk, hypothetical input, work outside SCOPE, taste without a rule, duplicate of a rejected finding.
judging.who: The cooperator (orchestrator) judges; auditors and reviewers report everything.

continuity: Fixes go back to the same worker, the next audit round to the same auditors, the delta to the same reviewer, all through SendMessage. A fresh agent is for independence or a different model tier.
